scope: unmodified ordinary starter weapons49001..49010 with explicit naked growth and sealing baselines
mapping_provenance: client_verified cattributedesconfig numid links and ordinary UI consumers; not a generic subtract-one rule
composition: recompute current naked growth value plus current equipped original flat totals; never add a delta to a previous equipped total
naked_basis: role-attributes-v1 explicitly excludes equipment; require exactly its plain RoleAttributeSnapshot and an independently recorded EquipmentAttributeBasis

sealing_basis.provenance: designed; old nine-field attribute baseline did not define sealing
sealing_basis.activation: record once in the current role transaction using explicit creation provenance or trusted supplied legacy basis; no inference from level, XP or missing fields
sealing_basis.legacy: explicit known sealing value and source required; do not silently migrate old attributes to0

equipment.source: immutable current InventorySnapshot read in the same caller transaction as growth/basis; preserve its inventory revision
equipment.eligibility: still owned, quantity1, weapon slot0, original roleNeed includes character config ID, known EquipmentCondition and identified clean EquipmentDetail with exactly original base_properties, no unimplemented quality modifier metadata
equipment.zero_durability: exclude original baseEffect while current durability is0, following equipment-condition-v1 designed rule
equipment.unknown_durability: reject projection; do not treat missing durability as positive
equipment.unsupported: reject unknown equipped templates/modifiers/slots rather than silently erase their effect or guess percentage formulas

display.values: absolute final totals; share the same committed projection between ordinary refresh and entry
display.bounds: nonnegative signed32 and exactly representable float32 before commit; overflow rolls back the asset command
display.vitals: do not change HP, MP, wound maxima or their versions for these three weapon effects

unsupported_systems: combat damage or sealing success-rate formula
